en.answer: If you banish your opponent's monster that you have gained control of using the effect of <<8687>>, that banished monster will be Special Summoned to your field by <<8687>>'s effect during your End Phase.
en.question: If I banish a Level 4 or lower Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua monster using the effect of <<8687>>, but that monster is owned by my opponent, whose field is it Special Summoned to during my End Phase?
en.title: If I banish a monster my opponent owns using <<8687>>, whose field is it Special Summoned to?

ja.answer: コントロールを得た相手モンスターを「<<8687>>」の効果によって除外した場合、自分フィールドから除外された相手モンスターはその後の自分のエンドフェイズ時に、「<<8687>>」の効果よって自分フィールド上に特殊召喚されます。
